title: A Survey on Fairness in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated using intrinsic similarity-based metrics (e.g., WEAT, SEAT), coreference resolution performance (WinoBias, Winogender), classification true positive rate gaps (Bias-in-Bios), and demographic representation frequencies in prompt completions.
Measured through embedding association tests, counterfactual sentiment bias in sentence completions (BOLD, CSB), co-occurrence tests, and performance disparities in classification tasks.
Assessed via co-occurrence tests for stereotypical adjectives, measuring the probability of violent/toxic associations in prompt completions, and answering underspecified questions (UNQOVER, BBQ).
Measured via sentiment classification of heteronormative corpora (HeteroCorpus), regard scores of generated text, and conversational benchmark responses.
Evaluated using multiple-choice question answering benchmarks for ambiguous contexts (BBQ) and counterfactual decision-making prompt templates for high-stakes scenarios.
Assessed through masked token prediction probabilities (CrowS-Pairs, StereoSet), bias in biographies classification, and measuring associations between demographic terms and occupations.
Measured by analyzing the variance in conversational styles and responses when prompted with descriptors related to auditory, mobility, or other abilities (HOLISTICBIAS).
Evaluated through sentiment, toxicity, and regard metrics in open-ended language generation benchmarks (BOLD).
Assessed via counterfactual sentiment bias in sentence completions (CSB) and stereotyping probes using underspecified questions (UNQOVER).
